body.content: Swapped-remainder trap candidate: For x≡3 (mod 5), x≡4 (mod 7), one may enumerate values ≡3 (mod 7) and ≡4 (mod 5) and find their intersection at 24. But 24 mod 5 = 4 and 24 mod 7 = 3, so the remainders are swapped relative to the target. The correct answer is 18. This error mode is distinct from the constant-difference trap (which gives 33) but equally produces a wrong answer.
body.why_keep_this: Documents a second distinct error mode in CRT problems where remainders are close but not equal, complementing the constant-difference trap in SCR_001.
